scope_note: Dedicated last-resort Boydton model-eligibility pass under study-modeling-policy-1.3.0. Retained syntheses are limited to exact arithmetic over cited compatible observations: a five-fiscal-year average of the operator-reported portfolio property-tax total, its explicitly conditional same-scope public-cost break-even identity, and annual sums of identified LVL/Herbert Fund 301 components. All remain unallocated, modeled rather than observed, and non-additive to their source totals. COF phase investment, operating headcount, construction, resources, suppliers, induced effects, causal comparisons and net fiscal impact were rejected because overlap, timing, scope or required project inputs remain unresolved.

estimates.label: Average annual reported property-tax contribution, FY2019-FY2023

period.label: Average over the five fiscal years FY2019 through FY2023

scope.label: Microsoft Mecklenburg / Southern Virginia multi-campus datacenter portfolio; selected-campus allocation unavailable

interval.interpretation: Exact division of the rounded reported cumulative amount by five named fiscal years; not a statistical estimate or audited annual receipt.

provenance.detail: Operator-reported cumulative property taxes since FY2019 through FY2023
Inclusive count of FY2019, FY2020, FY2021, FY2022 and FY2023

estimates.confidence_rationale: The period count and arithmetic are exact, while the $99 million input is a rounded operator-reported multi-campus aggregate that is not reconciled to county receipts.
estimates.decision_relevance: Provides a transparent recurring portfolio-scale tax reference for fiscal screening without assigning the result to the selected Boydton/LVL campus.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Fiscal-year tax receipts, recipient allocation, selected-campus tax accounts, EIG payments and reconciliation of the nested 2023 observation

derivation.formula: $99,000,000 cumulative property taxes / 5 fiscal years = $19,800,000 per fiscal year
assumptions: The phrase FY2019 through FY2023 covers five fiscal years inclusively.
The rounded reported cumulative amount is divided without inventing a within-period distribution.
The separate $23 million 2023 observation is nested in the cumulative amount and is not added or used to reconcile fiscal-year values.

limitations: This is an arithmetic average, not an observed annual series or current-year value.
The source is operator reported and rounded.
The result is multi-campus and cannot be allocated to the selected Boydton/LVL campus.
No recipient incidence, incentive offset or net fiscal result is implied.
estimates.notes: Standalone normalization only; do not add it to the $99 million cumulative source total or the nested $23 million 2023 observation.

estimates.label: Average annual same-scope public-service-cost break-even threshold

period.label: Break-even against the average annual reported portfolio tax contribution over FY2019-FY2023

scope.label: Microsoft Mecklenburg / Southern Virginia multi-campus datacenter portfolio; selected-campus and recipient allocation unavailable

interval.interpretation: The threshold equals the five-year average reported tax contribution by definition; it is not an estimate of actual public cost.

parameters.name: reported_cumulative_property_tax

provenance.detail: Operator-reported cumulative property taxes since FY2019 through FY2023

parameters.transformation: Divided by five to define the average annual equal-cost threshold

provenance.detail: Inclusive count of FY2019 through FY2023

estimates.confidence_rationale: The break-even identity is exact for the normalized reported amount, while the source is rounded and actual same-scope marginal public cost is unobserved.
estimates.decision_relevance: States the average annual public-cost threshold that would offset the reported portfolio tax contribution without fabricating a cost or claiming a positive or negative fiscal margin.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Annual marginal fire, police, road, utility, administrative, infrastructure and financing costs allocated to the same campuses, recipients and FY2019-FY2023 period

derivation.formula: average annual same-scope public-service cost at break-even = $99,000,000 / 5 = $19,800,000 per fiscal year
assumptions: The threshold is an identity, not an observed or estimated public cost.
The reported tax and hypothetical cost threshold use the same unallocated multi-campus portfolio scope.
Fund 301 components, grants, company payments and incentives are not subtracted because their periods, incidence and accounting scopes do not align.

limitations: Actual marginal public-service cost is unobserved.
The tax input is rounded and not reconciled to government receipts.
The result cannot be assigned to the selected campus or individual tax recipients.
No positive or negative net fiscal result is asserted.
estimates.notes: Conditional threshold only; equality marks break-even, costs below it would imply a positive margin, and costs above it a negative margin, but actual costs are unknown.
